cards.back:
Words of help about what to do. This is a noun.
Bahasa Indonesia: nasihat
Example: The nurse gave us good advice about washing our hands.
cards.say: advice. Words of help about what to do. This is a noun. The nurse gave us good advice about washing our hands.

cards.back:
To tell someone what you think they should do. This is a verb.
Bahasa Indonesia: menasihati
Example: I advise you to wear a coat in the rain.
cards.say: advise. To tell someone what you think they should do. This is a verb. I advise you to wear a coat in the rain.

cards.back:
Without any covering or clothes.
Bahasa Indonesia: telanjang, kosong
Example: The children walked on bare feet across the warm sand.
cards.say: bare. Without any covering or clothes. The children walked on bare feet across the warm sand.

cards.back:
To carry, or to put up with something.
Bahasa Indonesia: menanggung, tahan
Example: I cannot bear the loud noise of the drill.
cards.say: bear. To carry, or to put up with something. I cannot bear the loud noise of the drill.

cards.back:
Not moving.
Bahasa Indonesia: diam, tidak bergerak
Example: The bus was stationary at the red light.
cards.say: stationary. Not moving. The bus was stationary at the red light.

cards.back:
Paper, pens and other writing items.
Bahasa Indonesia: alat tulis
Example: She bought new stationery for the start of term.
cards.say: stationery. Paper, pens and other writing items. She bought new stationery for the start of term.

cards.back:
Something that completes or goes well with another.
Bahasa Indonesia: pelengkap
Example: Rice is a perfect complement to the spicy curry.
cards.say: complement. Something that completes or goes well with another. Rice is a perfect complement to the spicy curry.

cards.back:
A kind remark about someone.
Bahasa Indonesia: pujian
Example: He gave me a compliment about my painting.
cards.say: compliment. A kind remark about someone. He gave me a compliment about my painting.

cards.back:
A group of people who make decisions.
Bahasa Indonesia: dewan
Example: The town council voted to build a new library.
cards.say: council. A group of people who make decisions. The town council voted to build a new library.

cards.back:
To give advice, or advice itself.
Bahasa Indonesia: memberi nasihat, konseling
Example: A teacher will counsel pupils who feel worried.
cards.say: counsel. To give advice, or advice itself. A teacher will counsel pupils who feel worried.

cards.back:
A small machine or tool made for a job. It is a noun.
Bahasa Indonesia: alat
Example: The new device measures how fast you run.
cards.say: device. A small machine or tool made for a job. It is a noun. The new device measures how fast you run.

cards.back:
To plan or invent something. It is a verb.
Bahasa Indonesia: merancang
Example: Scientists devise careful tests to check their new ideas.
cards.say: devise. To plan or invent something. It is a verb. Scientists devise careful tests to check their new ideas.

cards.back:
A dry land with very little rain.
Bahasa Indonesia: gurun
Example: Camels cross the desert carrying water and food.
cards.say: desert. A dry land with very little rain. Camels cross the desert carrying water and food.

cards.back:
A sweet course at the end of a meal.
Bahasa Indonesia: hidangan penutup
Example: We shared a sweet mango dessert after our big lunch.
cards.say: dessert. A sweet course at the end of a meal. We shared a sweet mango dessert after our big lunch.

cards.back:
The main city of a country.
Bahasa Indonesia: ibu kota
Example: Jakarta is the capital city of Indonesia and its busiest port.
cards.say: capital. The main city of a country. Jakarta is the capital city of Indonesia and its busiest port.

cards.back:
The building in Washington where the US Congress meets.
Bahasa Indonesia: gedung Capitol, tempat Kongres AS bersidang
Example: Tourists photographed the white Capitol building in Washington.
cards.say: Capitol. The building in Washington where the US Congress meets. Tourists photographed the white Capitol building in Washington.

cards.back:
The air you take in and let out. This is a noun.
Bahasa Indonesia: napas
Example: Take a deep breath before you dive in.
cards.say: breath. The air you take in and let out. This is a noun. Take a deep breath before you dive in.

cards.back:
To take air in and out. This is a verb.
Bahasa Indonesia: bernapas
Example: We breathe more quickly when we run up the hill.
cards.say: breathe. To take air in and out. This is a verb. We breathe more quickly when we run up the hill.

cards.back:
To go first and show the way.
Bahasa Indonesia: memimpin
Example: Please lead the group along the forest path.
cards.say: lead. To go first and show the way. Please lead the group along the forest path.

cards.back:
The past form of lead.
Bahasa Indonesia: memimpin (bentuk lampau dari lead)
Example: The guide led us safely down the mountain.
cards.say: led. The past form of lead. The guide led us safely down the mountain.

cards.back:
To change something.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengubah
Example: The tailor will alter the trousers so they fit.
cards.say: alter. To change something. The tailor will alter the trousers so they fit.

cards.back:
A table used for religious ceremonies.
Bahasa Indonesia: altar
Example: Flowers lay on the altar in the quiet temple.
cards.say: altar. A table used for religious ceremonies. Flowers lay on the altar in the quiet temple.

cards.back:
To go on or continue.
Bahasa Indonesia: melanjutkan
Example: You may proceed to the next level of the game.
cards.say: proceed. To go on or continue. You may proceed to the next level of the game.

cards.back:
To come before something.
Bahasa Indonesia: mendahului
Example: A flash of lightning will precede the thunder.
cards.say: precede. To come before something. A flash of lightning will precede the thunder.
